style_profile.name: Corrupted Void Violet
style_profile.brief: A near-black, palette-tinted enemy silhouette with a bright reactor, hard stepped facets, one-sided violet fringe, and escalating corrupted fracture energy.
style_profile.application: Apply the corrupted-void material language to the same enemy identity at four sequential evolution stages. Preserve geometry and current archetype colors; add only the declared shader delta for each stage.
must_preserve: Pixel-locked edges and high-contrast reactor focus
Incremental evolution from the base treatment rather than four unrelated looks

references.description: Existing Gen III candidate to revise; preserve composition and geometry while increasing shader detail.
Tight crop of the current Redjack Mk II model preview used as the fixed geometry reference; excludes presentation labels.
Approved corrupted-void violet enemy treatment from the earlier shader comparison.
